Pros: 1) more content than any other app I've found. +3 stars.  Cons: 1) Magoosh does not belong on a flash card. i'm 99.9% sure that it will NOT be on the actual test. -2 stars. 2) Word Cycling is terrible. a) I often get a word in the "learning" category again only 2 cards later. of course i know the answer, i just had the word 2 cards ago. if i had mastered most of the words it wouldn't be so annoying. but this is at a point of 2 words mastered, 6 reviewing, 12 learning (yeah, my vocab sucks). There are 30 more words i haven't seen yet, that could be more useful than the word i just saw 2 cards ago. - 1 star. b) with a similar completion level as part A, i will often get into loops of 5-6 words that i am reviewing. -1 Star.  unfortunately its the most concise app i have found, so i guess i'll have to continue being angry with its flaws

It makes me practice several times words that I know VERY well. My advice is to mark all the words as known and make flashcards of the ones you don't know or you'll waste time. I've also bought Kaplan's and Manhattan's flashcards. The words on this list are truly relevant for the GRE.

The app is really good and helps remember words well. Some of the problems I faced is that if you mark a word as known in a new list, that word will never come up again for revision. There should be a side feature where all words appear together. Another thing where I feel the app lacks is a Search Bar. It would be really amazing if we get a search bar to directly search a word in this and the flashcard pops up for it. Other than this, it's an amazing app. Would give 5 stars if this is done.

Also, after revising a deck of 51 words for 10 minutes, I am not sure if all the words came!! But it wouldn't take me 5 mins to review all 51 mastered words if the words didn't repeat. But the way each word described is not good, there should be a little more explanation for the words like an example or an image to remember perhaps and must have include synonyms for each word.Despite the above rest is good. Great app. Just a few suggestions that will make it better. 1. Mnemonic devices (I can't stress this enough in words) 2. Synonyms and Antonyms with tags that can lead us to that word and definition if clicked on. Thanks!!

However this feature of word repetition also prevents the users from revising words that they actually want to. My suggestion to the developer team is to introduce the feature of word selection, so that users can themselves select words that they actually want to revise, rather than merely showing up words repeatedly that they are already familiar with. Thanks!

Honestly the app is nice, it helps you study a lot of words for the GRE. I however believe that it should have a better algorithm to show you new words at your own pace, like Anki does (a similar flashcard memorization app).

This is a great app for learning GRE words hassel free. With this I'm able to learn up to 50 words a day. There's this one feature missing from the app that can have huge impact on learning process. You can't bookmark and make your own word list, So when you're reviewing mastered words, you have to go through all of them which takes a long time for each deck.

The app has a straight forward user interface. I like it overall and will continue to use it. I find myself looking up some of the words in webster's dictionary to learn more about words that share the same root. It's easier for me to remember a word when I know other words that are related to it. So I wish that some of the definitions were more in-depth within the app. Including synonyms would be nice too.

The app is great for memorizing the words. My one complain is that the cards don't instantly turn when you press them it turns on second or 3rd press. Gets very annoying during review. Also please add an option to turn a Mastered word to Learning. If you misclick once might as well say good bye to that word.

Brilliant app! I find it extremely helpful for my prep. My mother loves it too though she already has a very strong vocab. It still helps her stay in touch with words that are not used that often in everyday speech. A few additional suggestions that would make the app a complete package - 1. Synonyms with tags that can lead us to that word and definition if clicked on. 2. Mnemonic definitions to help remember the words. 3. One overall repository where frequent weak words can get stored. Thanks!!

I definitely recommend this app to anyone studying the GRE. Magoosh has painstakingly selected most tested words. we all know that English words can have multiple meaning which makes it hard for one to know which one to focus on, this has been taken care of. What more is that studying with the app will help you eliminate false mastery as you do not know the next word that will show up. you also get to keep learning  or reviewing the ones you do not know until you have mastered it. I love this app particularly for providing contextual use of the words with instances that will actually help one to commit the words to memory. Magoosh also understood that test takers are always hard on themselves, so they throw in examples that will force that laugh out of your stern face. That said, i think one improvement which is , allowing users to go back and review words that they had difficulty learning after mastery, is highly needed. . For instance, i have mastered the first deck of 50words since last months, but l know there are words i want to look over again, but when i click on the deck, there's no way i could select those words that I want to see. Overall is a good app and 100% free

The words with their respectful meaning are of great quality. The algorithm to train your mind and learn the words are also up to the mark. The only difficulty I experienced was when I try to get the pronunciation of a particular word it get's mute and this has happened to me a lot of times. I still don't knock how to make this right.

Very nice app, the three levels of vocabulary mastery are an effective way to learn new words, and the often humorous example sentences help you build connections to the words that make it easier ro remeber them. One major problem though: There is no way to see all words in a deck, making it unnecessarily hard to revisit a fully mastered deck.

This app is really effective for learning words prevalent in gre. The only issue is, whenever I want to know the meaning of a particular word on my mind, I have to keep scrolling the flashcards. It would be great if all the words and their respective meanings are available in a list format.

Amazing application, really like the words and they way the level gets like "Learning, Revising and Mastered". One thing I found was words in Magoosh Vocabulary Builder (GRE section) are not in same order as in FCs, the advanced in VB was in common words here, so I had to switch to this app. The only scope of improvement which can make this application a power pack is, addition pictures or mnemonic along with sentences. If that is done, this app will rule any student's GRE prep.

I wish there was a back button to just go right back to the card previously bc sometimes I accidentally hit the wrong thing! Also it would be nice if I could reset individual decks instead of all/none. Other than that, a very simple and not bad app.

Pretty exhaustive collection of words and rightly segregated. Randomised repetition of words helped with learning. Quizzing for general words is a great service. Could've been better if it was provided for difficult words as well.

The thing lacking is a custom deck. Like a deck containing words from the decks chosen by the user. Lets say i am revising deck 1 to 3 so now i had to go deck by deck and since words are unique so i know since its deck number 2 chortle means laughing merrily. But in real case i wont be able to do it. So kindly add an option of custom deck

I mean all flashcards should be given equal chances and not just be displayed randomly recurrent and and must keep a record and the app should engender the quantity of cards too

Excellent. It's just that the fill in the blank activity has blanks that follow an "a" or an "an", narrowing down the potential answers. Changing the indefinite article to "a(n)" should fix this—or only listing words that share the quality of starting with either a vowel or a consonant sound.
It's very useful. It tracks the words I have learned and helps me to remember the news ones. Not always the explanation are enough, many times I have to use an online dictionary as an extra tool.

Awesome app to go through vocab.. Only one suggestion - add option to clear a particular deck of cards and allow to replay them again, instead of clearing all 1000 words.. Other than this it is far better than any other flash card app..

Reset all Decks functionality doesn't work, I have completed about half of all the flash cards and now I cannot seem to reset the decks. Is there a limit to the amount of times we can reset the decks? If yes, it needs to be explicitly specified. Edit :- Thank you for the prompt reply. I had an Android software update pending. After updating, the reset decks issue got solved. Will update this space if any other grievance arises

It would have been perfect if they would have given mnemonics for the words. Please add mnemonics so that it will be really easy to remember. Otherwise, the app is good.

Helps in retaining words, if revised regularly, the new fill in the blank update is very helpful, would have given 5 stars but one thing is missing, I want deck wise option to reset as it would make revision much better.

Very good! I would recommend adding an overview all words found within a particular section to avoid clicking through every single word to just to find the one you were looking for.
It would be great if you could add "Fill in the blanks" card for Basic and Advance words also. They are extremely helpful in increasing familiarity with the words and learn its usage.

Amazing app! However it would be really helpful if you could introduce a feature by wish I can add certain flashcards from the lists to a personalized list so that all the words that I find difficult are in one place

Amazing ad free large set of vocab flashcards. It tailors your experience by making you re-answer flashcard definitions that you missed in the past. My only request for the magoosh team is that there be maybe two sentence examples with each word so users could get a better idea of what real-world use is like

Really good app, but i would love to see the following: 1. For each section be able to see a list of all the words in it. 2. Include an option to swipe right and left for yes and no. 3. Include the phonetic transcription of the words.
Sign up Error There is an error, after installing this app it gives an error when I try to create an account in order to save my web progress. I think overall performance is good.

One suggestion for the fillin the blanks cards: in case of a incorrect answer, the flashcard should also show the meaning of the chosen incorrect option. This way we can know why the chosen option was incorrect.
It's a good app for building vocabulary.. although would've been better if there was an option for picking up some particular flashcards by ourselves and review them all together..

Best method to learn GRE words. I find the approach used in the app very effective and unlike the approach other apps use. The app categorizes the words to three, learning, reviewing, and mastered. That would make reviewing them a lot easier.

This is the kind of app i wanted to learn english words from. I wanted an app which have chunking of words in the form of some categories. In this app words are categorized in basic, medium and advanced level. So, while revising it would be easier for me to know that how much part i have completed and how far i have to go by looking at the chunks left to study. Thanks Magoosh

Everything's good. just some suggestions to increase usability: 1. App should have a little pause before pronouncing, so the user can take the cellphone to his ear(from call speaker) also before the voice begins. 2. App should have the feature of showing the whole list of words from a deck once completed, so that we can find or revise something specific. 3. App should have a search option where we can search for any word and it opens its explanation and tells the deck that it belongs to.

I love how this app helped me master new words and recall the ones I knew. I suggest the app to offer a place for the learners to write examples and maybe share them. In this way, we are more likely to remember the word in a more intimate way.

This app provides you with fascinating word lists perfect for the GRE and those want to know many useful words. Please make it available for the users to have a complete list of all the words that are provided in the app. Or at least at the end of each list after the learner covers all the words.

The gold standard, especially for NATIVE speakers seeking to expand their vocabulary. Highly engaging way to learn new words quickly. I learnt over 100 new words in 2 days. The app shows you a random sequence of flashcards each containing a different word. On the click of a button, it reveals the meaning of the word along with a sample usage in a sentence. You can then categorise the word as known or unknown and accordingly the word will be repeated in the sequence just as many times as needed for you to master it. Great strategy, quite addicting

This app was really great,as it helped me prep for the test on the go. I could prepare with it anywhere, anytime. I am bound to give this app ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ rating for its wonderful purpose for all GRE aspirants. The simplicity, oh!, no complicated mechanics, no wierd gamification of anything. It gives me words, their definition and one sentence. It ends there, i don't have to go through a jungle of garbage for the core of the app. It's orgasmic.

The app is organized into "flashcards" that include 50 words per deck and really focus on the mastery of each term.
